=== Blueprints ===
Contributors: IONOS
Requires at least: 5.0
Tested up to: 6.1
Requires PHP: 5.6

Use an existing WordPress site as a blueprint for your next project.

== Description ==
Export blueprint files with information about plugins and themes to import them elsewhere.

== Installation ==
See https://codex.wordpress.org/Managing_Plugins#Installing_Plugins for further instructions how to install a plugin.
